items.text: Werpö Lawi kï: Kersyon nko Koat nko Merari.
Kitïng Koat wor angwan, Amram nko Isar nko Epron nko Usiel.
Kitïng Amram wor odeny, Aron nko Musa nko cheptö akonga nyo kikuro Miriam. Kitïng Aron wor angwan, Nadap nko Apiu nko Eleasar nko Itamar.
Kiyï Eleasar Pineas, kïyï Pineas Apisyua,
kiyï Apisyua Puki, kïyï Puki Usi,
kiyï Usi Seraya, kïyï Seraya Merayot,
kiyï Merayot Amaria, kïyï Amaria Aitup,
kiyï Aitup Sadok, kïyï Sadok Aimaas,
kiyï Aimaas Asaria, kïyï Asaria Yoanan,
akïyï Yoanan Asaria, nyo kipöghisïyi ompö Kö pö Tororöt* nyay kitek Solomon ompö Yerusalem.
Kiyï Asaria Amaria, kïyï Amaria Aitup,
kiyï Aitup Sadok, kïyï Sadok Syalum,
kiyï Syalum Ilkia, kïyï Ilkia Asaria,
kiyï Asaria Seraya, kïyï Seraya Yeosadak,
Kirang pöytoghin Nepukadnesa Yeosadak nko pipö Yuda walak nko pipö Yerusalem ompöwölo kichömchï ECHOTYON kwigh lenyoni.
Monïnge walaka cho pö Lawi
Kitïng Lawi wor sömök: Kersyon nko Koat nko Merari.
Chï kï kaynötut pö werpö Kersyon: Lipni nko Syimey.
Chï kï werpö Koat: Amram nko Isar nko Epron nko Usiel.
Chï kï werpö Merari: Mali nko Musyi.
Monïngo Kersyon kï: Lipni nko Yaat nko Sima
nko Yoa nko Ido nko Sera nko Yeateray.
Monïngo Koat kï: Aminadap nko Kora nko Asir
nko Elkana nko Epiasap nko Asir
nko Taat nko Uriel nko Usia nko Syaul.
Kitïng Elkana wor odeny, Amasay nko Aimot.
Chï kï monïngo Aimot: Elkana nko Sopay nko Naat.
Nko Elyap nko Yeroam nko Elkana.
Kitïng Samwel wor odeny: Yoel nyo le poretye nko Apiya.
Chï kï monïngo Merari: Mali nko Lipni nko Syimey nko Usa
nko Syimea nko Akia nko Asaya.
Tumi Kö pö Tororöt
Chï kï pich cho kitö Daudi kïlïkwï tumi ompö Yerusalem Kö pö Tororöt otini kikip Santuku Muma* wölini.
Kitumöy chane chik ompö Ema nyo mi ECHOTYON* otini kitomönye kïtek Solomon Kö pö Tororöt.
Chï kï pich cho pö ortïn cho kigh ighisyononi! Ara Koat kï Eman wero Yoel nyo kile kintöghoghinto tumï cho tagh. Orenyi ntökwit Yakopo kï Eman nko Yoel nko Samwel nko
nko Elkana nko Yeroam Eliel nko Toa
nko Sup nko Elkana nko Maat nko Amasay
nko Elkana nko Yoel nko Asaria nko Sepania
nko Taat nko Asir nko Epiasap nko Kora
nko Isar nko Koat nko Lawi nko Yakopo.
Asap nyo kile kintöghoghinto tumï cho pö odeny. Orenyi ntökwit Lawi kï: Asap nko Perekia nko Syimea
nko Mikael nko Paaseia nko Malkicha
nko Etni nko Sera nko Adaya
nko Etan nko Sima nko Syimey
nko Yaat nko Kersyon nko Lawi.
Etan nyo pö ara Merari nyo kile kintöghoghinto tumï cho pö sömök. Orenyi ntökwit Lawi kï: Etnan nko Kisyi nko Apdi nko Maluk
nko Asyapia nko Amasya nko Ilkia
nko Amsi nko Pani nko Syemer
nko Mali nko Musyi nko Merari nko Lawi.
Kikitö werkökwa walaka cho pö Lawi kwigh ighisyö ompö Kö pö Tororöt.
Monïngo Aron

Kitötö Aron nko werkachi ropöw cho ngutoy cho onyïn nko amöros ompö atay kïpelo amöros nko saghat ompö Wölo Tïlil Tya* nko amöros nyo kimötoghchïnegho Tororöt pipö Israel ngokikwa. Kigh choni lapay le ato kimwochï Musa mötworinto ECHOTYON chane.
Chï kï monïngo Aron: Eleasar nko Pineas nko Apisyua
nko Puki nko Usi nko Seraya
nko Merayot nko Amaria nko Aitup
nko Sadok nko Aimaas.
Wölo kimang pipö Lawi
Anyï wölo kikitö monïngo Aron cho pö ara Koat, kinyorï chane kor nyo pö tagh nyo kinya ketö pipö Lawi.
Kikitö Epron nyo mi Yuda nko wölo kyoketïyi kyakï kuwitwit.
Ketö Kalep wero Yepune pareniko kanasyante nko kanastine cho mïnkech.
Chï kï kanastin cho kïryöghchini cho kikitö monïngo Aron: Epron nko Yatir nko kanastina Lipna nko Estemoa
nko Ilen nko Depir
nko Asyan nko Pet Syemes nko wölo oketïyi kyakï.
Kikitö ara Penchamen kanastinechï nko wölo oketïyi kyakï: Kepa nko Alemet nko Anatot, kanastin löwïr cho pö ortïnekwa kï taman nko sömök.
Kikitö ompö kura kanastin taman cho pö ara Manase cho pö ara Koat kïrïp kegh nko korikwa.
Ketö ara Kersyon ompö korikwa kanastin taman nko sömök ompö ara Isakar nko Asyer nko Naptali nko ara Manase cho pö kongasis cho mi Pasyan.
Ketö lenyoni tïkwïl ara Merari ompö korikwa kanastin taman nko odeny ompö ara Rupen nko Kad nko Saplon.
Kutö nyu pipö Israel pipö Lawi kanastin nko wölo oketïyi kyakï.
Kitö chane tïkwïl ompö kura kanastine choni pö Yuda nko Simion nko Penchamen.
Kikitö pipö ara Koat walaka kanastin nko wölo oketïyi kyakï ompö kanastina Epraim.
Kikitö chane kanastinechï: Syekem nyo mi komoswo Epraim nko Keser
nko Yokmeam nko Pet Oron
nko Ayalon nko Katrimon.
Kikitö chane kanastina Aner nko Pileam nko wölo oketïyi kyakï ompö koro pipö Manase cho mi okumpö ta.
Kikitö ara Kersyon kanastinechï nko wölo oketïyi kyakï:
Ompö ara pipö Manase cho mi kongasis kï: Kolan nyo mi Pasyan nko Astarot.*
Ompö koro Isakar kï: Kedes nko Daperat
nko Ramot nko Anem.
Ompö koro Asyer kï: Masyal nko Apdon
Ukok nko Reop.
Ompö koro Naptali kï: Kedes nyo mi Kalilaya nko Amon nko Kiryataim.
Ketö pipö Merari cho kingötï kanastinechï nko wölo oketïyi:
Ompö koro Saplon kï: Rimono nko Tapor.
Ompö koro Rupen ompö kongasispa lalwa Yordan tawu Yeriko kï: Peser ompö surkwen nko Yaasa
nko Kedemot nko Mepat.
Ompö koro Kad kï: Ramot nyo mi Kiliad nko Maanaim
nko Espon nko Yaser.
Monïngo Isakar
